[!dolt] skip
# Test bd defer and undefer change ready visibility
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Deferred task' --description 'Park this until later' --json
extractid ISSUE

bd defer $ISSUE --until tomorrow --json
jq '.[0].status'
stdout '"deferred"'

bd ready
! stdout 'Deferred task'

bd undefer $ISSUE --json
jq '.[0].status'
stdout '"open"'

bd ready
stdout 'Deferred task'
